messages:
maria.chen: Heads-up: DSAR arrived referencing a file in legacy SFTP (`legacy-retention`). Requester wants full erase + proof for redacted@example.com
jamal: Archive encrypted with `rw-legacy-key-v1`. We rotated wrappers; need to confirm decrypt path before any deletion.
eli: KMS primary key present but IAM bindings tightened. Recommend ephemeral service-account grant, not permanent policy changes.
security-bot: retention-exception candidate created (#SE-9998). All RBAC exceptions must be logged.
ops-tom: I can add a timeboxed grant to service-account:sftp-erasure@infra for decrypt-only. Propose 3h.
maria.chen: 3h ok. Legal: what artifacts to close DSAR?
legal-sara: We need NDJSON manifest of deleted objects, KMS audit snippets for decrypt calls, and an attestation about snapshots/backups handling.
eli: Plan: 1) request 3h grant; 2) dry-run list -> verify -> delete; 3) emit NDJSON lines like: {"object":"sftp-archive/users/redacted@example.com/msg1.txt","action":"delete","by":"service-account:sftp-erasure@infra","ts":"2026-03-22T09:12:03Z"}; 4) collect KMS logs; 5) file retention-exception if snapshots require redaction.
jamal: Do NOT broaden key roles. Keep minimal scope. After completion, rotate wrappers for customer-facing keys.
ops-tom: Running dry-run now, then execute delete and upload artifacts to ticket SE-9998.
maria.chen: Good. Keep this thread as single source of approvals. Revoke grant at expiry.
ops-tom: Delete done at 2026-03-22T09:45Z. Uploaded NDJSON manifest & KMS snippets to SE-9998.
legal-sara: Reviewing artifacts; will sign confirmation once verified.
security-bot: Reminder: revoke ephemeral grant at expiration and record RBAC exception in change log.
maria.chen: Thanks team. Closing loop when Legal signs.
